stories.title: In a divided America, the left and right unite to oppose artificial intelligence data centers
stories.simple_summary: Both Democratic and Republican politicians are working together to oppose the building of huge data centers that use lots of electricity to power AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: If these centers don't get built, AI development might slow down, which could affect new AI tools you might use — but this is mainly a political story right now.

stories.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
stories.simple_summary: An Indian company called Ringg that makes AI voice technology received $10 million in funding to help it grow.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
stories.simple_summary: A robotics company became worth $3 billion — that means investors think it will be very successful at building physical robots controlled by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and robotics engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is shutting down a service that Jeff Bezos once described as using humans to fake artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a news story about Amazon's business decisions — nothing relevant to you.

stories.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
stories.simple_summary: A top executive who ran the data centers at OpenAI (the company behind ChatGPT) has left the company, and there have been several other important people leaving too.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech professionals — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller’s WSJ Op-Ed Criticizing Bessent Was Written With AI - News of the United States
stories.simple_summary: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller admitted that AI wrote an opinion piece he published in the Wall Street Journal.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that important people are using AI to write — good to be aware of when reading opinions online.

stories.title: With limited AI policies, teachers take different approaches in the classroom
stories.simple_summary: Schools don't have clear rules about AI yet, so different teachers are handling it in different ways in their classrooms.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, they might be learning with different AI policies depending on their teacher.

stories.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
stories.simple_summary: A company called Stability AI that makes software to create pictures from words just raised $76 million from investors.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
stories.simple_summary: Claude, an AI assistant, can now remember things you've told it across different conversations — like how a good assistant keeps notes about your preferences.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude, you won't have to re-explain things each time you chat with it.

stories.title: Why the threat from the rampaging AI machine went ignored | Letters
stories.simple_summary: This is a letters section article — the headline alone doesn't give enough information to explain what was ignored.
stories.why_it_matters: Without seeing the actual letter, we can't say what this means.

stories.title: 90 Percent of Execs Say Oops, AI Didn’t Help Productivity, So Layoffs Will Continue
stories.simple_summary: A survey found that 9 out of 10 business leaders say AI didn't actually make their workers more productive, and companies are now laying off employees anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a business, this is a reminder that AI doesn't automatically help — you need to think carefully about whether it actually solves your problems.

stories.title: Try to beat this AI writing detector
stories.simple_summary: The Washington Post created a game where you try to guess whether a piece of writing was done by AI or by a human.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly entertainment — but it shows that AI writing is getting good enough that it's becoming hard to tell the difference.
